//: Windows Terminal fragment: adds the shared xeoTheme colour scheme without
touching settings.json, which stays user-owned (it holds machine-specific
profile GUIDs and paths and is rewritten by Terminal's own settings UI).
Same xeoTheme palette as wezterm, Starship, OpenCode and herdr's
A scheme of the same name inside settings.json takes precedence over a
fragment, so an inline xeoTheme entry there would shadow this one and
silently freeze its colours. Observed behaviour: a running Windows
Terminal drops the redundant inline copy on its next save once this
fragment provides the same name, leaving the fragment as the only source.
If an inline copy ever reappears, delete it rather than editing both.
